mx.teacher_note: spreading through available space -> no fixed shape or volume happens first, and that produces free motion in all directions and negligible attraction.

intelligence.enrichment: In gases, particles move freely in all directions and interparticle attractions are negligible, so gases spread to fill available space and have no fixed shape or fixed volume. free motion in all directions and negligible attraction -> spreading through available space -> no fixed shape or volume The learner explains that gas particles move freely in all directions with negligible attractions, so gas spreads through available connected space and has no fixed shape or volume. Gas is empty space, so smoke spreads by itself without needing moving air particles.
